It is also important to change your menstrual products regularly, whether you are using pads, tampons, or menstrual cups, to prevent bacterial growth and reduce odor. If soreness persists or worsens despite these measures, consult a healthcare provider to rule out infections or other underlying conditions that may require specific treatment.

Since toilet paper can be rough and irritating to skin, buy some simple feminine wipes to use during your period. These will soothe your skin and provide a cooling relief.
